Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The bidder must submit a valid compliance certificate as per the provision of the public procurement (pr eference to MII) order and provide an MSME registration certificate of relevant product category if applicab le. 5. The bidder shall submit an undertaking on their letter confirming the supply of item as per the uploaded specifications. 6. No J&K entry tax exemption will be provided by the buyer, bidder must clearly indicate the applicable J& K entry tax in their quoted rates. The same will be considered for the purpose of bid evaluation and compa rison. The bidder shall submit an undertaking on their official letter head duly signed and stamped confirm ing compliance. 7. The bidder must submit a valid GST registration certificate along with GST payment, copy of GS T certifi cate with last three months GST challan and GST 3B return for last one year. 8. The bidder must submit factory license / oem certificate of relevant items (if applicable). 9. The bidder shall furnish an Affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper stating that the firm/ company is not bl acklisted by any ministry / govt department / PSU. The bid no. and the date of issuance of this affidavit is a fter the publication of this bid. 10. The bidder must submit the required documents and achieve a technical score according to the attach ed ranking methodology for technical evaluation as qcbs evaluation criteria as annexed. 11. The bidder shall submit a separate undertaking on their official letter head duly signed and stamped c onfirming compliance that no extra charges will be charged for delivery. 12. The bidder shall submit a separate undertaking on their official letter head duly signed and stamped f or technical evaluation and confirming compliance that the sample must be forwarded for approval of item before supply. 13. The bidder shall submit a separate undertaking on their official letter head duly signed and stamped fo r technical evaluation and confirming compliance that the supplied items are branded. 14. The bidder shall submit a separate undertaking on their official letter head duly signed and stamped th at All documents uploaded by the bidder must be self-attested and digitally signed with a valid Class 3 Digi tal Signature Certificate (DSC). Any overwriting, tampering, illegible scanning, or submission of forged/ ma nipulated certificates (including MSME, MII, or GST certificates) will lead to immediate rejection. 15. Pre-bid meeting: Pre bid meeting is compulsory to understand the exact specification, colour, shape, si ze and place of installation of items. 16. The bidder shall submit a separate undertaking on their official letter head duly signed and stamped th at the bidder must have successfully executed similar supply orders of goods/ consumables to Central/ Sta te Government Departments, PSUs, or reputed educational institutions in the last 3 financial years. Copies of work orders and satisfactory completion certificates must be uploaded. Bidders with a record of default, poor performance, or legal disputes with government entities will be disqualified. 17.
